subject: Balance bridging, invoice timeline and VAT evidence for end-of-term true-up
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@parksidemobile.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Chu <achu@parksidemobile.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:15:00-05:00
Subject: Request: end-of-term numbers and VAT evidence for true-up

Hi Grace,

We're pulling our books closed for Q4 and need the final usage statement and invoice for the contract true-up (PL-2024-089). Two asks from finance:

1) A consolidated statement showing the usage breakdown by month (Aug–Nov 2026) that maps to line items on the final invoice.
2) VAT documentation: Redwood's VAT certificate and the invoice with the VAT line separated (we have EU presence and need our AP team to validate).

Can you confirm an expected invoice date and whether we should expect any pro-rated credits from the capped seats change in Sept? Our target is to post the invoice by 11/30 so AP can process payment in Dec.

Attachments: none

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Head of Ops, Parkside Mobile
lydia.park@parksidemobile.com

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@parksidemobile.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: end-of-term numbers and VAT evidence for true-up

Hi Lydia — thanks for the note and the deadline heads-up. Quick update and plan: 

- We'll produce a single reconciled statement that maps usage to invoice lines. Marissa (finance ops) will assemble the pro-forma invoice.
- Redwood VAT certificate and an invoice template with VAT broken out can be provided as separate attachments.
- Regarding the Sept seat cap change: we're running a short reconciliation to determine if there is a credit due; Ben is pulling the seat history.

Target timeline:
- 11/24: draft reconciled statement + provisional invoice (no VAT applied yet) for your review.
- 11/27: final invoice with VAT lines + Redwood VAT cert attached, depending on your EU entity flag.
- 11/30: official PDF invoice issued for payment.

If Parkside needs the invoice earlier for month-end close, we can accelerate the provisional invoice to 11/22 but would need the formal PO to be in place. What's your PO cadence?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@parksidemobile.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T08:30:00-05:00
Subject: Parkside Q4 reconciled statement + provisional invoice (attached)

Hi Lydia / Grace — attaching the draft reconciled statement ("Parkside_Q4_trueup_statement.pdf") and a provisional invoice CSV that maps tokens/embeddings to invoice lines. Highlights and action items: 

- Total delta for true-up: $42,180.00 (pre-VAT). Line items are month-bucketed Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov with usage and rate used.
- Seat-cap adjustment (Sept): results in a $1,250.00 credit, already reflected in the statement.
- VAT: we did not apply VAT because we need Parkside's EU VAT number or a confirmation of your billing entity. If you are billing from Parkside US entity, we'll issue a VAT-exempt invoice; if EU, we will apply 20% VAT for reconciliation purposes and provide Redwood_VAT_certificate_2026.pdf.

Next steps we need from Parkside:
1) Confirm billing entity and VAT number (if applicable).
2) Provide formal PO or PO confirmation number so we can finalize invoice PDF.

Attachments: Parkside_Q4_trueup_statement.pdf (statement), provisional_invoice_mapping.csv

Thanks — I can move the final invoice to 11/27 if we get PO + VAT confirmation by EOD 11/26.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Aaron Chu <achu@parksidemobile.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@parksidemobile.com>, procure@parksidemobile.com
Date: 2026-11-26T10:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Parkside Q4 reconciled statement + provisional invoice (attached)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — attaching the PO (PO_2026-11-29_12345.pdf). Parkside will be billed to Parkside Mobile Inc. (US entity). No EU VAT applies. For our records: please add our PO number to the invoice PDF and confirm final amount due.

Also: we need a short "proof of delivery / service" statement to satisfy our internal auditors showing the service period and the feature set billed (embedding + chat inference). If you could include a single-paragraph statement on Redwood letterhead or include a PDF stub, that would be ideal.

Aaron Chu
Finance Manager, Parkside Mobile
achu@parksidemobile.com

Attachment: PO_2026-11-29_12345.pdf

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@parksidemobile.com>, Aaron Chu <achu@parksidemobile.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T16:42:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Parkside Q4 reconciled statement + provisional invoice (final invoice issued)

Team / Parkside — final update: invoice has been approved and issued. Summary: 

- Final invoice #RWD-PL-2026-11030 for $40,930.00 (pre-tax) — seat credit applied.
- No VAT applied per Parkside confirmation (US entity).
- Attachments sent to Parkside: Parkside_Q4_trueup_statement.pdf, Redwood_VAT_certificate_2026.pdf (for your records), and a short proof-of-service note inserted into the invoice PDF.
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date (2026-11-30).

Grace — please monitor until payment posts and flag any collection friction. Ben — save the reconciled statement and PO to the customer ledger. Marissa — confirm the invoice was uploaded to our billing system and HubSpot deal updated (I see the link).

Lydia / Aaron — thanks for the quick turnaround on the PO. Please confirm receipt and that the invoice and attachments are sufficient for your AP team. If you need the invoice in a different format (XML/Peppol), let us know.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_invoice_RWD-PL-2026-11030.pdf (issued)
